name: skills
description: Authored Claude Code agent skills. deploy runs the whole landing sequence for finished work on a branch — merge, version bump, changelog, annotated tag, push, branch and worktree cleanup — and ships the branch unmodified. design-patterns runs a short dialog to settle the shape of code before it is written — naming the axis of change, starting from the direct version, and leaving the choice open. explain-it-to-me turns a body of git work into a briefing that reads the diff rather than rewording the log. markdown is a design spec for .md files that survive the renderer they end up in. run-script-handoff covers the conventions for handing a human a command to run in their own terminal and paste back. nasa-coding-standards applies a TypeScript port of the NASA/JPL Power of 10 to code that moves money, changes access, cannot be undone, crosses a trust boundary, or waits on external state — bounding loops, memory and recursion, closing failure paths, and disclosing every rule it changed code under.
